task_definition.task_description: Please look up Sony electronics for me, then check similar recommendations for the Sony WH-1000XM5 and choose the silver version as an alternative with a quantity of 2. After that, hold those 2 items, confirm the order, then check my checking account balance and create a medium-priority in-app “Trip Summary” note using that balance data with finance and travel tags.

Once that’s done, check my checking account balance and use that balance information to create a medium-priority in-app note titled Trip Summary with the tags finance and travel.
